file_id: Md. Sadiquzzaman vs Unknown on 18 May, 2023

sentences.text:
Md. Sadiquzzaman vs Unknown on 18 May, 2023
Author: Bibek Chaudhuri

In the matter of : Md. Sadiquzzaman Mr. Biswajit Manna,
Mr. Aritra Bhattacharyya ...for the petitioner.
The petitioner is the father-in-law of the opposite party no. 2.

On the basis of a written complaint Bidhannagar Women Police Station Case No. 32/2020 dated 3 rd December, 2020 under Sections 498A/406/307/313/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act was registered and the said case is pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Bidhannagar.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Bidhannagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: I have carefully perused the FIR being sworn by the learned Advocate for the petitioner, except an allegation that in presence of the petitioner and the mother- in-law of the opposite party her husband assaulted her and they had kept quiet, there is no other allegation in the four corners of the written complaint.
In the aforesaid case, charge-sheet has been submitted against the petitioner.
The petitioner has prayed for quashing of the charge-sheet The instant revision be admitted.
Petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party under registered speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service within two weeks after vacation.
State of West Bengal be served through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.
In the meantime, further proceeding in connection with GR Case No. 853/2020 be stayed as against present petitioner till 15th August, 2023.
